name: NEONTRIP Supplier Payment Reminder Email v0.1 (INACTIVE DRAFT)

parameters.content: Inactive draft for Sales-Vergabe payment reminders. Triggered only by the Ops app button through SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_REMINDER_WEBHOOK_URL. The Ops app reserves the reminder in Supabase with reminderKey before this workflow sends the customer-visible email. This workflow validates recipientEmail, paymentLink, sale.id and reminderKey, sends via Outlook, and returns a provider message id. Do not use Outlook Email Trigger here.
